what_the_baseline_is: ASD (anti-siphon device) — the incumbent passive gravity-compensation architecture — plus the standard valve catheter as the null baseline. The R339 buyer package comparison table covers 4 postures at 10/20/30/40 mmHg: damper vs ASD vs standard.
what_the_device_does: A passive hydraulic damper inline with the CSF shunt that damps postural flow transients — a compressible-element/annular-gap proportional resistance element reacting to the hydrostatic pressure step of posture change, rather than a binary anti-siphon membrane or a programmable valve setting.
